entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: I wonder... what Mom would say if she[n]saw me now.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Would she praise me for the choices[n]I've made? Or...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I don't wish to put words in her mouth,[n]but you have nothing to fear. Through[n]those choices, you have come so far.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: If I were her, I would be proud.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Heyyy... You're not allowed to tug my[n]heartstrings like this, Inari!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: I always wanted to show you this, Sojiro![n]Isn't it awesome? Cute, too!

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Erm... Cute?

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: I swear, keepin' up with you kids is[n]gettin' harder and harder with each[n]passing day.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: I talked to myself in a world made by[n]my own heart, and then got this as my[n]Persona...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Sounds pretty crazy when you think[n]about it. Fact is stranger than anime.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: We were surprised too. Your case was[n]a little unusual, after all.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: And your navigation skills even surpass[n]mine... I'm envious.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: But we need you to be the Phantom[n]Thieves' mascot! Don't worry, just[n]leave the navigation to me!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: It was pretty shocking the first time[n]we saw this. Like Futaba was getting[n]abducted by her Persona.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: It did make quite a scene.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: You know, I've always wondered what it[n]might look like on the inside.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Me too! We should totally ask her next[n]time!

entries.speaker: Yoshida
entries.en: Ah, this looks familiar... Wasn't this sort[n]of thing popular back in the day?

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Right, I do remember some other kids[n]goin' on about UFOs, and... crypids?[n]Somethin' like that.

entries.speaker: Yoshida
entries.en: Yes, exactly! Those were good times.

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: Holy crap... Is that a UFO? It is, isn't it!?

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: I never thought I'd see one of those...

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: Help! Somebody call the authorities[n]before we get abducted like cows!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Um... I'm not sure what you're talking[n]about, but I think you should calm down.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Y'know, when Futaba joined the[n]Phantom Thieves...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: What about it?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I... said some shit I shouldn't have.[n]That you were useless, and stuff.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: So, uh... I'm sorry!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Ryuji...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Why are you apologizing? Do you have[n]a fever?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Just take the apology and shut up!

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: I'm glad you two are getting along.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Our Phantom Thieves outfits come from[n]within our own hearts, right?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: I actually like the design I ended up with.[n]Good job, me!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Within our own hearts, huh. I wonder[n]why mine turned out like... that.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Personally, I think the spikes on my[n]shoulders are wholly unnecessary.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Dang. Well, I think you guys rock 'em.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Your Persona's a bit like a vehicle too,[n]isn't it, Futaba? Can you fit more than[n]one person in there?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Doubt it. It's pretty cramped, and not[n]made to hold a lot of weight. It'd[n]probably just crash to the ground.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: But it's okay, we've got Mona to drive us[n]around!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Heh! Of course! What would you guys[n]do without me? Really, it worries me[n]that you all rely on me so much!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: So he says with a smile.
